summary: TotalEnergies SE filed a Form 6-K providing recent developments, including a routine disclosure of share repurchases (424,713 shares at a weighted average price of EUR78.01, totaling €33.1M) conducted between April 27-29, 2026 under shareholder authorization. Other exhibits describe a supercomputer project, an offshore wind project filing, an employee capital increase, and shareholder meeting documents. No special situation—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or forced management change—is present. This is a standard current report of routine corporate and operational updates.
